events.boundary: Already modifies the pre-existing open state; no person is inferred to have opened the window.
Visual disappearance behind cloud means becoming not visible; no actual physical destruction or disappearance from the sky is asserted.
The sent-item derivation is a postal parcel; yesterday is an exact past-day temporal role, not a location.
Bridge developed a crack overnight; not necessarily collapse or unsafe for use.
Missed a stage cue is a narrow performance timing failure, not mislaid a physical object or suffered memory loss.

nonassertions.lexical_decision: Parcel as dispatched item; return-shipper V1 passive, not animate V0 came back
nonassertions.boundary: Refusing to claim a parcel was returned does not deny return or assert the parcel was delivered.

nonassertions.lexical_decision: Musical performance conductor as professional; stop-playing music event as nominalized performance, not finished concert
nonassertions.boundary: Not claiming a conductor stopped playing says nothing about whether it continued.

nonassertions.lexical_decision: Sensor perception means detect movement through instrument; does not imply a human visually saw anything
nonassertions.boundary: Declined claim does not negate detection nor prove a false sensor.
